impressions.text: The change prices every token-bearing OpenCode message, including compaction messages, and adds regression coverage for exact totals, tiering, and tokenless-message exclusion.
The worker reported green configured checks and passing local format, lint, typecheck, tests, build, smoke, and knip verification.

The worker stopped short of the live acceptance check after gateway access was denied; the orchestrator ran it and reported that this build showed an exact $5.98 rather than the prior lower-bound result.
